title: Bring the manager's worker panes back after a restart
notes: Follow-up from #155 (manager terminals). The manager's worker panes (manager-terminal-<n>) do not come back after the app restarts: session-store keys saved pages by project path, and the manager is not in that list. Project pages already restore their panes and resume their Claude sessions; the manager's should too.

comments.body: From #299 (#187): after a restart, the workers popup lists a restored worker under nobody, though session.json keeps its dispatcher (dispatcherOf in session-requests.ts). Fix that here too, since this card restores the workers. Builds on #299; start after it merges.
#299 is merged. Do not bump the version. Run typecheck, lint and test; tests are Windows-safe.

PR #301: manager workers' conversations saved under session.json's manager list and resumed by the manager's folder; workers popup lists restored workers under their saved dispatcher. Checks pass; restart path not hand-checked.
Pull request #301 opened: Bring the manager's worker panes back after a restart https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/301

Review loop converged in 2 rounds, ready to merge. Merged main in to resolve a board-card conflict (cabeb0cf); round 1 posted 2 findings, both fixed in c59326b3; round 2 re-review left 0 open threads. CI: 5/5 checks pass on head c59326b3.
